title: Invasion effects: planet values and a decline for builds
description: Payments that arise inside an invasion (the custodians' six influence on the first landing on Mecatol Rex, a Dunlain Reaper's two resources, Freelancers' unit) used to show up in the invasion card as bare 'exhaust <planet> for N' buttons, without the planets' values or a running total. They now use the ordinary payment panel and map badges: resource and influence value beside every payable planet, the total staged against the cost. Building as a consequence of invasion (Freelancers, and every other single-unit production) now has a decline in the engine, and the invasion card shows it. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server; regenerate with npm run screenshots -- CP.

shots.heading: Custodians offer
shots.caption: First landing on Mecatol Rex: the engine offers to remove the custodians token for 6 influence (unchanged).

shots.heading: Custodians payment: values per planet
shots.caption: After 'remove it', the payment panel opens instead of exhaust buttons: each planet shows its resource and influence value (influence highlighted), and the button counts what is still owed.

shots.heading: Custodians payment: staged
shots.caption: After Auto-pay (or picking planets) the running total meets the 6 influence and Pay is enabled.

shots.heading: Custodians payment on the map
shots.caption: Pick on map: payable planets carry badges with both values while the invasion is still under way.

shots.heading: Custodians payment, 390x844
shots.caption: Same panel on a phone, no horizontal scroll.

shots.heading: Build after invasion with decline
shots.caption: Freelancers explored on the new planet: each unit by name and cost, plus 'Decline: build nothing' (sends the engine's new decline option).

notes.title: Web
notes.text: ChoiceRendererDispatcher no longer hands the invader's payment questions to the InvasionOverlay; the payment workflow (PaymentDrawer, PaymentBar, map payment marks) renders them. boardPresentation keeps payment mode on during invasions. Other seats still see the invasion overlay while the invader pays.

notes.title: Engine
notes.text: production::produce_one (Freelancers, Chaos Mapping, Minister of Industry) ends its unit question with a decline (appended last, so unit option ids and positions are unchanged); answering it builds and pays nothing. Freelancers' question is named ('Freelancers: produce one unit in <system>') and typed: subtype produce_one_unit, source Content(frln*), optional, about the system.
